result.summary: The page looks mostly functional and well-structured. One notable visual issue was identified related to text truncation.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated without an ellipsis, making it appear like incomplete or broken text rather than intentionally clipped content.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis or ensure the card width accommodates enough of the name to be recognizable, or add '...' to signal truncation to the user.
